name: Haunted Snuggly Bear
skillFull: Collecting a certain number of Bear Jellies will cause a Ghost Bear to appear. After scaring you, the Ghost Bear will create Ghost Bear Jellies. Level Up for more Ghost Bear Jelly Points. (Each Bear Jelly will reduce the Treasure's counter by 1. Giant Bear Jellies reduce the counter significantly more.)
